stage: grooming; synthetic installed-source observations, not product/runtime/provider conformance

results.assertion: Explicit singleton option returns the same SSR client in a synthetic Node process
results.limitation: No real browser, cookie, auth/session or socket qualification; explicit isSingleton avoids relying on browser globals.

results.assertion: Same topic returns the existing RealtimeChannel even when requested private config differs
results.limitation: No provider join/policy test. Topic configuration must remain invariant; use scoped generation and reference ownership.

results.assertion: httpSend uses REST while disconnected and preserves private=true
results.limitation: Synthetic HTTP202 only; it is not evidence of broker, subscriber delivery or live permission.

results.assertion: Presence track forwards caller-supplied actor/name without identity attestation
results.limitation: Demonstrates client API behaviour; authorization policies and a future authoritative actor lookup are separate.

results.assertion: httpSend rejects non-202 rather than resolving success:false
results.limitation: Synthetic HTTP500. Network timeout and provider faults need implementation qualification.

results.assertion: Installed Tiptap returns null transaction selector for absent shouldRerenderOnTransaction
results.limitation: Source inspection only; does not measure parent/component render cost or browser interaction.
